description: This PHP class, EmpWorkExperienceDecorator, serves as a decorator for the EmpWorkExperience entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and format work experience dates, associate employees by employee number, and calculate the duration of employment based on date differences.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperienceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmpWorkExperience entity providing formatting and association methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpWorkExperience instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the underlying EmpWorkExperience entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the work experience based on its employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'from' date of the work experience.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted 'to' date of the work experience.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration of employment in years based on date differences.
